graph TB
  C[\Plan\]
  C -->|lbl| D[/a "quoted" step\]
  A & D -->|lbl| C
  D --> C[[x < y]]
  B --o C(((Run tests)))
  C -. dotted .-> D@{ shape: brace }
  A --- D[\fa:fa-check step/]
  A -- "quoted" --> A{Ünï}
  C --- A{Plan}
  subgraph C["Group"]
    D -- text --> A
  end
  subgraph D["Ünï group"]
    A ~~~ D
  end
  B[(Plan)]
  D --- D{Run tests}
  subgraph D["Group"]
    D -.- D
  end
  B e1@--> B(Ünï)
  B@{ label: "$$E=mc2$$" }
  D & C -->|lbl| A
  B & D --> D
  A:::hot
  D & C == thick ==> D

  D & Ünï ~~~ Start
  漢 -->|lbl| B(tab	here)
  n_2 & C --x|cross| C
  Start[/Ship it\]
  Ünï --- 漢@{ label: "Ship it" }
  Ünï & D -.- D
  漢[/Plan\]
  Ünï <--> E[/fa:fa-check step/]
  C>tab	here]
  subgraph A["Group"]
    Start --x|cross| D
  end
  Start(((fa:fa-check step)))
  x1 & n_2 -. dotted .-> 漢
  E & B -.-> n_2
  Ünï -->|lbl| D[$$E=mc2$$]
  C --- A@{ label: "Ünï" }
  Start --x|cross| E@{ shape: fork }
  n_2:::hot
  subgraph Start["Group"]
    Ünï -.- label .- x1
  end

flowchart-elk LR
  C --o Ünï[(tab	here)]
  A & x1 --x|cross| n_2
  A & E e2@==> x1
  E ---> n_2[/long label that keeps going well past the wrapping width/]
  subgraph B["Ünï group"]
    x1 == thick ==> D
  end
  n_2 & x1 --> D
  n_2{Run tests}
  B & B --o A
  A --x|cross| A([Ship it])
  A == thick ==> B[\tab	here\]
  x1@{ shape: st-rect, label: "tab	here" }
  A((Ship it))
  A -.- E[Plan]
  A{{Ship it}}
  C & E -.- label .- A
  A(x < y)
  n_2>x < y]
  A -->|lbl| Ünï{{fa:fa-check step}}
  D --> E:::hot
  B[/$$E=mc2$$\]
  x1 ---> B
  x1[\x < y\]

cases.source:
flowchart RL
  C & A --o B
  D --- A[\**bold** step\]
  subgraph A["Group"]
    A --o B
  end
  C[[x < y]]
  D & C --- C
  D & B --o B
  C & B e1@--> D
  C["`**x < y** md`"]
  A((**bold** step))
  D -.-> A@{ shape: circle, label: "a "quoted" step" }
  D@{ shape: trapezoid }
  B["tab	here"]

flowchart TB
  Ünï(x < y)
  n_2 & E --- A
  E & n_2 -.-> Ünï
  E & x1 -. dotted .-> n_2
  E["x < y"]
  subgraph C["Group"]
    n_2 ==> Ünï
  end
  D
  n_2 & Ünï ~~~ E
  A -- "quoted" --> D[/**bold** step/]
  x1 --o B((Run tests))
  x1 == thick ==> D[/x < y\]
  x1[/Run tests\]
  D(x < y)
  D[\x < y/]
  B e1@--> A@{ label: "Run tests" }
  Ünï -- text --> n_2@{ label: "Run tests" }
  D ~~~ x1[\**bold** step\]
  A{tab	here}
  A <--> A(((long label that keeps going well past the wrapping width)))
  Ünï[\x < y/]
  D --> E[fa:fa-check step]
  C == thick ==> C:::hot
  Ünï>x < y]

cases.source:
graph LR
  B -.- label .- E[/tab	here\]
  C ---> E[\tab	here\]
  subgraph Ünï["Group"]
    C ~~~ B
  end
  B e2@==> B[/Ship it/]
  C[[Plan]]
  A -- "quoted" --> C[\Ünï/]
  E & E --x|cross| E
  D --x C[\$$E=mc2$$\]
  subgraph E["Group"]
    C ---> C
  end
  A ==> B((x < y))
  E & B -.- label .- C
  C[\x < y/]
  B --o Ünï@{ shape: bolt }
  E -.- C[Ship it]
  subgraph D["Ünï group"]
    E ~~~ A
  end
  C & D --> A
  Ünï e2@==> C[/Ünï\]

graph LR
  C[tab	here]
  E & C == thick ==> A
  D --- A["`**fa:fa-check step** md`"]
  x1 & B ~~~ B
  Ünï[(**bold** step)]
  B:::hot
  C -.- label .- B[($$E=mc2$$)]
  E[\a "quoted" step\]
  C -->|lbl| x1([x < y])
  B[\tab	here\]
  E ==> A[[tab	here]]
  B(((tab	here)))
  subgraph B["Ünï group"]
    A ---> D
  end
  x1 == thick ==> D{{Run tests}}
  A <--> Ünï[/$$E=mc2$$\]
  B@{ shape: bogus }
  C --o Ünï([**bold** step])
  x1[\x < y\]
  x1 & B -.-> C
  A --- D[/**bold** step/]
  Ünï[\long label that keeps going well past the wrapping width/]
  B:::hot
  C --x|cross| x1["`**Plan** md`"]
  A --o A((Ünï))
  A -.- E[/a "quoted" step/]
  Ünï & C -. dotted .-> x1
